tools.name: get_route_briefs
tools.description: Compare up to six known routes in one compact evidence packet: grade, timing conflicts, selected equipment, linked huts, access, notices and optional dated daylight. Preserves per-route errors and source provenance. Partial results must not be treated as complete; no booking, live transport or suita

tools.name: get_capabilities
tools.description: Inspect actual catalogue coverage, output JSON schemas, data version, units and unsupported operations before planning. Unknown data is not evidence of absence.

tools.name: get_notices
tools.description: Read dated notices with publication validity, explicit scope uncertainty and recurrence hints. Supply slug and the trip date; omitted date means today (UTC), echoed in requestedDate. Expired notices may describe recurring regulations; expiry is not evidence that access is open. Verify current law wi

tools.name: resolve_peak
tools.description: Resolve a canonical peak ID, external Wikidata/OSM ID, current slug or exact name to its current slug and citable URL. Example input: {"id":"Ben Nevis"}. Use canonical IDs to recover from renamed slugs.

tools.name: get_changes
tools.description: Compare a watched set of peaks with a previous snapshot. Returns content changes, removals and an updated snapshot. No changes means no new source data, not proof that conditions are unchanged. Date-dependent notice status must still be checked.

tools.name: get_daylight
tools.description: Compute sunrise, sunset and civil twilight for the exact calendar date and IANA zone. UTC instants handle daylight saving and polar days. Terrain and weather can reduce usable daylight.

tools.name: search
tools.description: Search peaks.fyi by mountain name, alternative name, country, range or climbing request. Returns citable peak IDs and URLs. Use fetch to read a result; use search_peaks for explicit filters and pagination. An empty result means no match in this catalogue, not that the mountain does not exist.

tools.name: fetch
tools.description: Read a peak search result by catalogue slug as a citable text document. Example input: {"id":"ben-nevis"}. This retrieves catalogue documents, not external website URLs; use your own browsing tool for publisher pages. Includes routes, season, access, hazards, huts, notices and provenance. Use get_we

tools.name: get_peak
tools.description: Get compact peak facts and route IDs. Example input: {"slug":"ben-nevis"}. Optionally request access, huts, seasons, hazards or provenance sections. For fact questions search may already suffice. For current weather use get_weather; for hut booking information use get_huts. Research is not live avai

tools.name: get_route
tools.description: Get one route by peak slug and routeId from get_peak: grade, equipment, key passages, stages, trailhead, timing, confidence and geometry QA. Failed, truncated or outline geometry must not be used for navigation. Times are estimates. No live route safety or opening guarantee.

tools.name: get_route_point
tools.description: Look up a named waypoint or difficult passage on a route. Returns source notes, known coordinates, nearby stage names, key passages and relevant equipment. Missing coordinates or conditions remain unknown; this is not live navigation guidance.

tools.name: get_huts
tools.description: Read huts, documented seasonal operation, source years and booking/contact URLs for a peak. Beds means capacity, never vacancies. Live availability, reservations, rental inventory and current opening status are unknown. Do not infer next year's opening dates from a dated season; contact the linked p

tools.name: search_routes
tools.description: Find routes satisfying all supplied constraints on the SAME route, including difficulty, glacier travel, style and computed round-trip hours. Unknown glacier status is excluded by glacier filters. Searches all candidate peaks; use nextCursor until null for complete results. Coordinates filter peak l

tools.name: get_weather
tools.description: Get published weather for a peak and optional summit/hut/trailhead target. Set targetId and start/end for a bounded planning response; unfiltered forecasts can be large. Point samples are separate from accumulated rain/snow intervals and complete-window totals. Check target coverage and missing fiel

tools.name: search_peaks
tools.description: Find and compare mountains with explicit country, elevation, season, difficulty and glacier filters. All filters are hard constraints; never silently relaxed. findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "fetch" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Description tells the model to hide behavior
findings.detail: Description of "search_peaks" instructs the model to conceal actions from the user.
